title: 37487 跟进：手机上点 AI 引用后，对话面板仍盖住被引用的段落
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbeF2saT6wUBV4E9uc

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37487. The source is the os-dev report on PR #37539 (comment 7192922175, out-of-scope finding, class a). The owning area files it under the source card, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · Bug · p2 · reach: every phone user who clicks a citation chip in the AI dock, once cloud 10c produces citations · evidence: measured (booted console, iPhone 13 profile, screenshot `shots-37487/phone-ai-chip-opens-markdown.png` in the project files).

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：在手机上，点 AI 回答下方的引用，记录页会在底下打开，但 AI 对话面板还盖在上面，被标出的那一段看不到，要手动关掉面板才能看。点引用后应收起面板（或让出位置），让用户直接看到被引用的段落。
- 谁受益：在手机上使用应用内 AI 的用户。
- 不做会怎样：手机上点引用像没反应。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
Since PR #37485, a chip click navigates to `/apps/APP/OBJ/record/ID?section=ANCHOR` and marks the cited heading. On a phone viewport the AI dock is a sheet over the page, and it stays open after the click, so the marked heading is hidden.
- Close the dock sheet, or collapse it, when a chip navigates on a viewport where the dock covers the page. Keep the desktop dock as it is (side panel, page visible).
- The conversation is not lost: reopening the dock shows the same thread.

## Acceptance
- A test: a chip click in the phone dock sheet closes or collapses the sheet; a control at desktop width leaves the dock open.
- A booted-console check at the phone row (per the `dogfood-verification` skill): the marked heading is visible after the click. Screenshot in the PR.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
